instruction: Set Chrome to clear all cookies and site data every time the browser is closed.

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt install jq -y

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling automatic data deletion when closing Chrome. The evaluator uses a custom getter get_clear_cookies_on_exit__936eec5ac877849802aeaa5f0c43e44f to check the Preferences file for actual cookie clearing on exit settings (browser.clear_data.cookies_basic, profile.content_settings.exceptions.cookies with session_only, or default_content_setting_values.cookies = 4). Custom metric function check_auto_delete_data__936eec5ac877849802aeaa5f0c43e44f compares the result against expected value 'true'.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly checks multiple Chrome Preferences locations for cookie clearing on exit settings
Line 59-62: Checks browser.clear_data.cookies_basic (valid for newer Chrome versions)
Line 64-76: Checks profile.content_settings.exceptions.cookies with session_only setting (valid approach)
Line 78-82: Correctly checks profile.default_content_setting_values.cookies == 4, where 4 = SESSION_ONLY (clear cookies on exit)
Line 85-90: Checks local_state.clear_browsing_data.cookies as additional fallback
Metric correctly compares result string against expected value 'true'
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to verify setting persistence across browser restarts
Coverage is complete: evaluator verifies the exact requirement in the instruction (auto-clear cookies on exit)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor improvement: Could add logging to indicate which specific setting location was found when returning 'true'
Optional: Consider adding a check for browser.clear_data.cookies_advanced as well for completeness
